godel.why: integrity and the pipeline check read names, text and imports (GODEL_AUDIT §4.3: integrity NO); they report the Gödel verdicts and check the core is not copied

name: integration

pipeline.tier_reason: the integrity and pipeline checks read every law, goal, capability, command, section and doc: exhaustive over names and text, blind to meaning

statement: One program: unique law and goal numbers, every law carried by a capability, every command, section and doc described, generated docs in sync, no goal easier than its floor.
usefulness: Parallel work lands as one working program, never as pieces.
